body:
Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
This is our final reminder regarding your account.
We have not been able to process the payment method on file, and your music service is scheduled to be deactivated on @DeactDate@.
To avoid an interruption to your service and a reactivation fee, please update your payment information before the end of today.
Your invoice (#@Order.OrderNumber@) is available here:
Download Invoice
Update your payment method in the customer Portal:
https://portal.dynamicmediamusic.com
Username:
@Contact.Email@
Temporary Password (if this is your first time logging in):
@Customer.CustomerID@
We’re here to help. If you need assistance, please call us at 586-978-4214.
Thank you,
Billing Team at Dynamic Media
